dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median intensity, representing an intermediate tonal phase between dark-slate and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency distribution of small, dark-grey speckles across the central and lateral dorsal surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the dark-pixel clusters and the primary light-grey baseline.

other_distinctive_markers: A clearly defined dark circular aperture representing the blowhole is visible on the anterior dorsal surface; a slightly darkened longitudinal line denotes the dorsal ridge in the posterior section.
